detailed_description: Fuel Cost Calculator estimates trip fuel and cost in the browser. Choose Metric (km, L/100km) or Imperial (mi, MPG), then enter distance, fuel efficiency, fuel price, and pick One Way or Round Trip. Results update reactively: fuel needed in liters or gallons, total cost shown with a fixed US dollar sign, cost per kilometer and cost per mile, and a short trip summary. Round trip simply doubles the entered distance. The tool does not fetch live fuel prices, convert between currencies, calculate CO2 emissions, support per-segment trips, or save trip history.
usage_steps: Pick the Metric or Imperial unit toggle
Enter the trip distance in km or miles
Enter the vehicle's fuel efficiency in L/100km or MPG
Enter the fuel price per liter or per gallon
Pick One Way or Round Trip; round trip doubles the distance
Read the fuel needed, total cost, cost per kilometer, cost per mile, and trip summary
usage_examples: Estimate fuel cost for a 200 km commute given a 7 L/100km car and a current pump price
Compare the cost per mile of two cars by entering different MPG values with the same fuel price
Plan a round trip drive by entering a one-way distance and toggling Round Trip to double it
Sanity-check a quoted travel reimbursement using the cost-per-kilometer breakdown
